context:
Goal: every check does the same thing when it can't read its input, as you asked on item 275 ("a more uniform issue").
Problem (rule): two rulings disagree. Decision ci-unknown-is-red says a check in CI that can't read its input fails. Decision stale-cites-at-merge, line 18, says: "A base that does not resolve (a shallow clone with no history) is unknown, not a finding. ... exits 0, so a repo that pins the action and checks out shallow is not red at its pin move" (owner-lane call, 2026-11-01). Line 19 also passes a run with FAIL=false. Line 18 is your ruling, so changing it needs your word.
Based on (ruling): stale-cites-at-merge lines 18-19 (2026-11-01).
Based on (ruling): decision ci-unknown-is-red.
Based on (measured): how many other checks pass on an unknown read is not measured. The step's first job is a sweep, starting from lint/check_unknown_reads_contract.py.
What line 18 protected: a child repo on a shallow checkout does not go red when it moves its pin. What protects that now: the lint fetches the full history once, then reads the base, so the child stays green and is still linted (item 275, choice c).
Departs from: stale-cites-at-merge line 18, where an unknown base passes — a rewrites it in place to point at ci-unknown-is-red and sweeps every other check to fail closed in CI.

Meanwhile: lane ste-lint-diff-fail-closed builds c on its branch, and its merge waits for this answer.
lane: coordinator: one rule for an unknown read, and rewrite stale-cites-at-merge line 18; routed 12:46 CST. Unblocks lane ste-lint-diff-fail-closed and item 275

lastAnswer.note: Granted. Routed 12:46 CST to the coordinator.

options.gain: Every check fails in CI when it can't read its input, so nothing passes unread. Child repos stay green because the lint fetches the full history first.
options.label: Grant: one rule, and rewrite line 18
options.lose: A sweep lane, and each check that passes on an unknown read today starts to fail until it is fixed.

options.label: Keep line 18 as written
options.lose: The two rulings still disagree, and a shallow clone still passes unread. Lane ste-lint-diff-fail-closed can't merge c.

short: One rule for an unknown read
title: Should every check fail in CI when it can't read its input, and should your stale-cites-at-merge ruling be rewritten to match?
why: Recommended: a. One rule ends the conflict, and the full-history fetch keeps what line 18 protected.
